BG_003.name: Greystep Mountain Trail
BG_003.prompt: a steep zig-zagging dirt trail up Greystep Mountain, scattered pine trees, lichen-covered rocks, wooden trail-marker posts with no writing, the toy-sized village of Thistledown far below in the valley

variants.DAY: clear late-afternoon light, long golden shadows

BG_004.name: Greystep Summit
BG_004.prompt: the flat rocky summit ridge of Greystep Mountain above a sea of clouds, distant blue peaks, a few hardy alpine flowers between flat stones

variants.PREDAWN: deep blue pre-dawn sky with a thin pink line on the horizon
variants.SUNRISE: brilliant golden sunrise breaking over the sea of clouds, warm rim light on everything
